messages:
ajay_sen: Starlight is ready to start Private POC in our VPC. They asked about how we handle KMS/HSM key handoff and certs for the on-prem connector. Can SRE/SE confirm the recommended path?

maria_sefton: quick recap from the call: they require customer-owned keys (BYOK) for data-at-rest, HSM attestation, and audit logs. Also want a short-lived API key for initial smoke tests.

lisa_acosta: We can do envelope encryption with customer's KMS and our runtime using an HSM-backed key for signing. Proposed handoff steps:
1) Customer provides KMS Key ARN or public wrapping key (PEM) via secure channel.
2) We create a CSR for the connector cert and POST it to their PKI endpoint / return signed cert.
3) Exchange of secrets via PGP-encrypted tar or presigned S3 URL with MFA.
I'll write the exact commands.

ben_platform: Prefer presigned S3 + one-time token for artifacts. For HSM-backed key material we cannot accept private key blobs. If they want to run the HSM locally, we support PKCS#11 connector with an attestation doc.

olivia_sec: Security checklist:
- Ensure customer private keys never land on our hosted control plane (if they request BYOK)
- Require signed attestation (HSM vendor) + cert chain
- Enable audit logging (syslog + cloudtrail) into their logging stack
- Rotate short-lived admin API keys after onboarding

ajay_sen: starlight asked if we can do SFTP instead of S3 due to their policy.

lisa_acosta: SFTP is okay. Two options:
- Customer uploads PGP-encrypted artifact to our SFTP box (we provide username + expires in 24h)
- Or they provide presigned S3 link scoped to single GET with IP restriction
We'll prefer S3 for automation but SFTP works for manual handoff.

ajay_sen: they also want a how-to for generating CSR and sharing the public key. Any snippet?

lisa_acosta: Here you go:
```
# generate RSA key pair
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -out starlight-private.key -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072
# CSR
openssl req -new -key starlight-private.key -out starlight.csr -subj "/C=US/ST=CA/L=SF/O=Starlight/OU=Sec/CN=connector.starlight.local"
# Export public key PEM
openssl rsa -in starlight-private.key -pubout -out starlight.pub.pem
```
Share only `starlight.csr` and `starlight.pub.pem`. Keep `starlight-private.key` offline.

ben_platform: On our side we'll return `connector.crt` signed by their CA or by our intermediate depending on agreement. We'll also provision a short-lived API key for smoke tests:
```
Key: ri-test-<random>
Expires: 1h
Scopes: inference:read, connection:register
```

olivia_sec: Add: they need to provide SOC2/HSM vendor attestation doc (pdf). Also, we must enforce KMS policy that disallows export of unwrapped keys if they use our cloud KMS.

maria_sefton: I've scheduled a technical handoff for Thurs 10am PT with their infra lead (derek@starlight). I'll send a calendar invite with the SFTP creds and the presigned S3 fallback. 

ajay_sen: One more: pricing for Dedicated vs Private POC — they asked about cost delta if we run the connector in their VPC vs our hosted private offering.

maria_sefton: I'll follow up with pricing. Short answer: Private (customer-hosted connector) has lower monthly infra on our side but requires eng time; Dedicated pool adds reserved capacity cost. I'll put details in the doc after handoff. 

deploy-bot: deploy 1785.2 started by ben_platform — provisioning sftp user for starlight (expires in 24h).

ajay_sen: Thanks all. Action items:
- lisa: draft step-by-step handoff doc + commands (by EOD)
- ben: create SFTP user & one-time API key (in progress)
- olivia: list of required compliance artifacts (attach to invite)
- maria: pricing follow-up and invite

lisa_acosta: I'll upload the doc to the invite and include the exact S3 presign command example:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-staging/starlight/keys.tgz --expires-in 3600
```

ajay_sen: Perfect. tagging customer contact: @derek_starlight — Derek, expect a calendar invite and SFTP details. Any constraints on file formats?

derek_starlight: Derek (customer): prefer tar.gz + PGP, we will not share private key material. We'll also attach HSM attestation PDF. Thanks.

maria_sefton: Closing loop—I'll post the meeting notes after Thurs. :thumbsup:
